text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day in the early afternoon, I spot<n>Grass
Wonder deep in contemplation.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I really shouldn't eat too much<n>more, but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. I'm trying to decide the<n>appropriate
amount of food for lunch.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's a little embarrassing to admit this,<n>but... I'm
afraid I may have already<n>gone and stuffed myself.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It was so lovely out, my<n>classmates and I had
tea together.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But I was having such a wonderful<n>time chatting
and drinking, I kept<n>reaching for sweet after sweet.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You should have seen it. Spe had a<n>treat in each
hand the whole time...<n>Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The question is, what am I to do now?<n>I suppose
you might consider this my<n>just deserts.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder looks to me for an<n>answer. It'd be
bad for her health if<n>she ate too much, but sweets
are no<n>substitute for a proper lunch...
choice_data_list: You know, gluttony is considered a sin.
You can't train well on an empty stomach.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... You might be right there. For<n>today, I should
practice restraint.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Still, our tea party was such a<n>treat. Won't
you join us next time,<n>Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I promise you I'll be moderate with<n>my sweets
intake. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Making tea with her friends seems to<n>have put
Grass Wonder in a good<n>mood.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well... I agree, a lackluster meal leads<n>to a
lackluster performance.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Having a balanced diet is part of<n>one's training
regimen. I might be<n>overeating a little, but my body
needs<n>its nutrients. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. With that settled, I'll have to<n>pick something
that compliments the<n>leftover tea...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder makes a conscious<n>effort to eat well
and better her<n>training.
